# Erik Aouizerate — CV

> Senior software engineer (AI, fullstack, DevOps) based in Toulouse, France. This file maps the canonical CV resources for agents and LLM tools.

## Canonical

- [CV — HTML](https://www.erik-aouizerate.me/): complete CV, server-rendered, with no application JavaScript.
- [CV — Markdown](https://www.erik-aouizerate.me/llms-full.txt): full CV content in Markdown for direct reading.
- [CV — PDF](https://www.erik-aouizerate.me/Erik_Aouizerate_CV.pdf): printable A4 version.

## Interactive

- [CV editor](https://www.erik-aouizerate.me/studio): filter skills and experiences. State lives in the URL fragment (`#cv=...`); this page is `noindex` and disallowed in `robots.txt`.
